title: [review] router.rs:326: Floating point ETX boundary co
description: The ETX validation uses 'etx < 1.0' for the lower bound. While semantically correct (perfect link = 1.0), floating point arithmetic computing ETX values could yield 0.9999999... or 1.0000001, causing unexpected rejection or acceptance at the boundary. Consider using an epsilon comparison or documenting the expected precision.
